summary: V2 adds 4 new Python backend packages (passlib[bcrypt], python-jose[cryptography], reportlab, openpyxl) and a new SECRET_KEY env var. 5 new DB tables are created via migration 0004. Zero new Node.js packages mandated at this stage — frontend auth + invoice UI ships via the V2 UI track and will declare its own npm additions. All V1 Docker / PostgreSQL / FastAPI / SQLAlchemy / Pydantic infrastructure is inherited unchanged.

packages.name: passlib[bcrypt]
packages.purpose: Bcrypt password hashing for tbl_user_master.password_hash. CryptContext provides constant-time comparison (domain/auth.py).

packages.name: python-jose[cryptography]
packages.purpose: JWT signing (HS256) and validation for access tokens. [cryptography] extra enables RS256 as a future upgrade path without package swap.

packages.name: reportlab
packages.purpose: PDF generation for Sales Report and Inward Report exports. Uses SimpleDocTemplate + Table + Paragraph primitives. No external binary dependencies.

packages.name: openpyxl
packages.purpose: XLSX generation for Sales Report and Inward Report exports. Two-worksheet layout (Consolidation + Transactions). Pure Python, no LibreOffice dependency.

services.name: PostgreSQL 16
services.setup_notes: Inherits from S1 docker-compose. Requires `alembic upgrade head` to apply migration 0004 (5 new tables) then `python scripts/seed_default_user.py` to create the default admin user.

services.name: Docker (testcontainers)
services.setup_notes: Test execution dependency only — inherits from S1. No new test infrastructure needed.

env_vars.name: DATABASE_URL
env_vars.description: Inherits from S1. PostgreSQL DSN. Backend cannot start without it.

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.description: Inherits from S1. Backend API base URL consumed by the Next.js frontend.

env_vars.name: SECRET_KEY
env_vars.description: NEW in V2. Cryptographic secret for signing JWT access tokens (HS256). Must be at least 32 random bytes. Never reuse across environments. Backend cannot start without it.
env_vars.example: openssl rand -hex 32  # generates a suitable value

env_vars.name: ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_HOURS
env_vars.description: NEW in V2. JWT access token TTL in hours. Defaults to 8 (one trading day) if not set. Override to lower for tighter security.

migrations.notes: ORM-first per DS-009. Generated from Base.metadata targeting only V2 models. Review DDL before applying to confirm autogenerate captured all constraints.

post_migration_scripts.purpose: Creates default SUPERVISOR account (admin / admin123). Idempotent.
post_migration_scripts.when: Once after alembic upgrade head on a fresh database.
post_migration_scripts.warning: Change the admin password immediately after first login.

no_breaking_changes_to: S1 master CRUD (read-only dependency — auth guard added via main.py include_router, not inside router files)
S2 transaction forms (same read-only dependency pattern)
S2 stock ledger writes (advisory lock + FOR UPDATE intact per DS-015)
S3 dashboard + sales report (SalesReportService reused by ReportExportService — no modification)
frontend_deps_note: TBD at /ases-ui-design V2. Anticipated additions: an HTTP interceptor that attaches the Bearer token from localStorage to every fetch (or axios instance), a login page component, and possibly a JWT-decode library (jwt-decode or similar) for reading role from the token client-side. Invoice and pricing pages are new and may need a numeric-input library for Decimal fields. All frontend packages will be declared in the V2 UI track deps manifest.

DS-017 (shared filter predicate — replicated in InwardReportService)
